LED “LED” LAMP

A lamp shaped like a giant LED, in white or multicolor.

Visit the link Its skills in the skill graph

Interests

Consumer ProductsInteractive Media

Skills used

CADCreative TechLEDs & LightingShop & Prototyping3D Printing
What it is

A lamp shaped like a giant LED. The white version has two legs like a normal LED; the multicolor version has four, like an RGB LED.

What I did
  • Designed it in CAD for looks and easy printing: a translucent PETG shell and base, aluminum pipe legs, a weighted base and a standard bulb socket.
  • Tested ways to get an even glow without visible layer lines: vase mode, scarf seams, diffusion film and spray.
  • Costed both versions in a bill of materials: about $49 in parts for the white lamp and $64 for the multicolor.
Result
  • The STL files are free to download, and there's a waitlist for finished lamps on prettygoodengineering.co.
  • Learned more about industrial design, manufacturability, and scalability for product design.
  • Videos went viral online (>300k views!)
